title: Bianchi identities in noncommutative geometry
summary: We first present an introduction to the differential geometry of noncommutative algebras that carry a representation of a triangular Hopf algebra. Their noncommutativity is encoded in the universal R-matrix. The differential geometry is canonically constructed from these data. We then develop a new approach to the Bianchi identities for curvature and torsion of arbitrary connections (not necessarily bimodule connections).
